description: This file declares the interface for interacting with the OVS database in the OvsAgent component. It contains function declarations for initializing, deinitializing, writing to, monitoring, canceling monitoring, deleting entries, and generating IDs within the OVS database.

methods.name: ovsdb_init
methods.description: Initializes the OVS database with a specified starting ID.

methods.name: ovsdb_deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes or cleans up resources associated with the OVS database.

methods.name: ovsdb_write
methods.description: Writes data to the OVS database, with a receipt callback.

methods.name: ovsdb_monitor
methods.description: Sets up a monitor on a specified OVS table with a callback for notifications.

methods.name: ovsdb_monitor_cancel
methods.description: Cancels a monitoring operation on the specified resource ID.

methods.name: ovsdb_delete
methods.description: Deletes an entry from an OVS table given a key-value pair.

methods.name: id_generate
methods.description: Generates and returns a new unique ID.
